spans.s: --a son of अधिसोमकृष्ण; when नागसाह्वय was washed away by floods, he made कौशाम्बी his capital; father of eight powerful sons. M. ५०. ७८-9.
--a kingdom of the east watered by ह्लादिनी. Br. II. १८. ५५; वा. ४७. ५२.
(II)--the name of the sun in the month of Nabhasya (भाद्रपद). भा. XII. ११. ३८; Br. II. २३. 9; Vi. II. १०. १०. M. १२६. १०.

(III)--a son of Aditi: आदित्य of the month श्रावण: a प्रजापति: born of कश्यप and दाक्षायणी--see सूर्य;
1: Br. II. २४. ३४, ८८, १२९;

; वा. ५२. ९१. ६५. ५३.

2: M. २५३. ४३; २६८. २१.
father of

--the chief of the fifth वातस्कन्ध, situated between the नक्षत्रस् (ऋक्ष-वा। प्।) and the planets;
1: Br.
--one of the four sons in the ३०थ् Kalpa of शर्व, red in colour, attire, etc. वा. २२. ३०. [page३-261+ २७]
--(विविक्तनामन्-भा। प्।)--a son of हिरण्य- retas of कुशद्वीप. भा. V. २०. १४.
--(Vividha-ब्र्। प्।): a son of Adbhuta Agni. वा. २९. ३९.
--(Vivici-वा। प्।): son of Adbhuta Agni, tutelary deity of expiatory penances (प्रायश्चित्त): Father of Arka. Br. II. १२. ४१; वा. २९. ३९.
--a son of विम्शपुत्र (विम्श-वि। प्।) and father of Khaninetra. वा. ८६. 6; Vi.
--a son of चाक्षुष, and father of Rambha. भा.
--by the passage of time क्षेत्रज्ञ becomes विवृत्त by a single reason; it is likened to a light of Khadyota in extreme darkness; he returns from अव्यक्त; he is a शरीरि and a महान्। वा. ५९. ७०-2.
